WITH RECURSIVE base AS (SELECT u.id AS user_id, DATE_SUB(#{date}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{date}) DAY) AS dt, 0 AS cnt, 0 AS state FROM users u
UNION ALL
SELECT b.user_id, DATE_SUB(b.dt, INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AS dt, b.cnt + (ws.state = 1) AS cnt, ws.state AS state FROM base b LEFT JOIN weekly_results ws ON ws.user_id = b.user_id AND ws.year_week = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(b.dt, INTERVAL 1 WEEK), '%Y-%u') WHERE ws.state IN (1, 3)), agg AS (SELECT user_id, MAX(cnt) AS streak FROM base GROUP BY user_id) UPDATE users u JOIN agg ON agg.user_id = u.id SET u.streak = agg.streak
